def reverse_complement(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise ValueError(\"Input must be a string\")
    
    # Validate characters
    valid_chars = set('ACGTNacgtn')
    if not all(c in valid_chars for c in text):
        raise ValueError(\"Input must contain only A, C, G, T, N (case insensitive)\")
    
    # Complement mapping
    complement_map = {
        'A': 'T', 'T': 'A', 'C': 'G', 'G': 'C', 'N': 'N',
        'a': 't', 't': 'a', 'c': 'g', 'g': 'c', 'n': 'n'
    }
    
    # Create complement and reverse
    result = ''.join(complement_map[c] for c in text)
    return result[::-1]
EOF"

def expand_tabstops(text, width):
    # Validate width parameter
    if not isinstance(width, int) or isinstance(width, bool):
        raise ValueError('width must be a positive built-in int')
    if width <= 0:
        raise ValueError('width must be a positive built-in int')
    
    result = []
    col = 0
    
    for char in text:
        if char == '\\n':
            result.append(char)
            col = 0
        elif char == '\\t':
            # Calculate spaces needed to reach next tab stop
            spaces_needed = width - (col % width)
            result.append(' ' * spaces_needed)
            col += spaces_needed
        else:
            result.append(char)
            col += 1
    
    return ''.join(result)
